mapper.select: select m.mime_type, m.file_size, m.storage_key from site_media m where m.public_id = #{publicId} and m.media_state = 'AVAILABLE' and m.del_flag = '0' and ( exists ( select 1 from site_media_reference reference_item inner join site_page page_item on reference_item.owner_type = 'PAGE_REVISION' and page_item.published_revision_id = reference_item.owner_id and page_item.del_flag = '0' where reference_item.media_id = m.media_id ) or exists ( select 1 from site_media_reference reference_item inner join site_article article_item on reference_item.owner_type = 'ARTICLE_REVISION' and article_item.published_revision_id = reference_item.owner_id and article_item.del_flag = '0' where reference_item.media_id = m.media_id ) or exists ( select 1 from site_media_reference reference_item inner join site_credential credential_item on reference_item.owner_type = 'CREDENTIAL_REVISION' and credential_item.published_revision_id = reference_item.owner_id and credential_item.del_flag = '0' where reference_item.media_id = m.media_id ) ) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into site_media (public_id, media_kind, original_filename, content_sha256, mime_type, file_size, media_state, storage_key, public_path, adopted_at, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{publicId}, #{mediaKind}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentSha256}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{mediaState}, #{storageKey}, #{publicPath}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select media_id from site_media where public_id = #{publicId} and media_state = 'AVAILABLE' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.delete: delete from site_media_reference where owner_type = #{ownerType} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: insert into site_media_reference (media_id, owner_type, owner_id, reference_role, field_key, sort_no) values (#{mediaId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{referenceRole}, #{fieldKey}, #{sortNo})
